title: ANIS-E - Shiny App
text: aim European Introduction Map inspect NIS richness MEOW ecoregion list species present selected region.  map composed polygons correspond MEOW ecoregions (see Spalding et al. 2007 description regions). polygon filled color represents number unique NIS recorded ecoregion. hover region, tooltip appears showing ecoregion name corresponding NIS count. can navigate map zooming panning mouse, trackpad, -screen controls. inspect specific region, simply click polygon. label “Selected Ecoregion(s)” update, species table located map refresh automatically display species present chosen region. also possible select multiple regions, case table aggregate species across selected areas. clear selections return default view, use Reset Table button.  species table displayed map contains several columns: taxonomy (Kindgom Species), AphiaID identifier linking species World Register Marine Species database, year taxon first reported area, MSFD subregion, associated Realm, Province, Ecoregion Marine Ecoregion World framework. table also specifies original source record.

title: ANIS-E - Shiny App
text: purpose Species Explorer inspect introduced native ranges selected species. Users can provide input either selecting directly taxonomic table entering species names AphiaIDs text box. Table mode, process straightforward: locate taxonomic table, click row select species, use species drop-menu adjust selection, allowing multiple species explored .  Text mode, input given manually. switch input text, choose taxonomic level (default Species, AphiaIDs disabled broader levels Genus Family1), paste one entry per line, either species name AphiaID (available taxonomic level choosen “Species”). example: Caulerpa taxifolia 417798 Homo sapiens  app displays warning box names IDs invalid. corrected, species drop-menu can used finalize set species examined. species selected, app displays single interactive map overlays introduced/cryptogenic native ranges time. legend clearly distinguishes categories users can interpret results easily. multiple species selected, overlapping regions styled distinctly, region contains introduced cryptogenic records, shown different color clarity. Note Native multiple sp. Introduced multiple sp. map legend indicate ecoregions native area two selected NIS, introduced region two NIS.  maps, two range tables provided. Introduced Range table lists regions selected species introduced cryptogenic, Native Range table lists native regions. tables include powerful functions global search, optional column filters, data export Copy (clipboard), CSV, Excel formats, scroll bars handle wide long datasets. Note data available given category (example, native polygons known species), corresponding panel remains empty.
